cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads, 1000% = 10 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (10240 MB = 10 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

port.desc: Port your app can listen on (TCP). It is also passed to the app as the PORT environment variable

goversion.desc: Version of Go (the official golang image) that builds and runs the app. A go.mod asking for a newer Go downloads that toolchain into the server folder

gitrepo.desc: HTTPS URL of a git repository to download on install, for example https://github.com/user/my-bot.git. Reinstalling pulls the latest commit. Leave empty to upload the files yourself

gitbranch.desc: Branch to check out. Empty means the default branch of the repository

gittoken.desc: Personal access token for a private repository (GitHub, GitLab). Leave empty for public repositories

buildtarget.desc: Package to build, relative to the server folder: . (the module root) or a path such as ./cmd/server

startargs.desc: Arguments passed to the app, for example -addr :8000

gorun.desc: Start the app with go run instead of building a binary first. go run does not pass the stop signal on, so the app gets no graceful shutdown

commands: bash -c "for f in main.go go.mod; do if grep -qs 'Placeholder written by Aether Panel' \"$f\"; then echo \"Removing the placeholder $f\"; rm -f \"$f\"; fi; done"

bash -c "set -e; if [ -z \"$GIT_REPO\" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ \"$(id -u)\" = 0 ] && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"Installing git in the install container\"; apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates >/dev/null; else echo \"git is not installed, it is needed to download the repository\"; exit 1; fi; fi; g() { git -c safe.directory='*' -c init.defaultBranch=main -c advice.detachedHead=false \"$@\"; }; auth=(); if [ -n \"$GIT_TOKEN\" ]; then auth=(-c \"http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic $(printf 'oauth2:%s' \"$GIT_TOKEN\" | base64 | tr -d '\\n')\"); fi; [ -d .git ] || g init -q; echo \"Fetching $GIT_REPO ${GIT_BRANCH:-(default branch)}\"; g \"${auth[@]}\" fetch -q --depth 1 \"$GIT_REPO\" \"${GIT_BRANCH:-HEAD}\"; g reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD; echo \"Checked out $(g log -1 --format='%h %s')\""
bash -c "if [ ! -e go.mod ] && [ ! -e main.go ]; then echo \"No Go code yet: writing a placeholder main.go and go.mod\"; cp .aether/placeholder/main.go .aether/placeholder/go.mod .; fi"

bash -c "set -e; export GOPATH=\"$PWD/.aether/go\" GOCACHE=\"$PWD/.aether/go-build\" GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=\"*\"; bin=\"$PWD/.aether/bin/app\"; mkdir -p .aether/bin; t=\"${buildtarget}\"; if [ \"$t\" != . ] && [ -f \"$t/go.mod\" ]; then cd \"$t\"; t=.; fi; if [ ! -f go.mod ]; then echo \"There is no go.mod, nothing to build\"; exit 0; fi; echo \"Downloading modules\"; go mod download; if [ \"${gorun}\" != true ]; then echo \"Building $t\"; go build -o \"$bin\" \"$t\"; fi"

run.command: bash -c "set -e; unset GIT_TOKEN; export GOPATH=\"$PWD/.aether/go\" GOCACHE=\"$PWD/.aether/go-build\" GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=\"*\"; if [ -f go.mod ] && ! grep -qs 'Placeholder written by Aether Panel' go.mod && grep -qs 'Placeholder written by Aether Panel' main.go; then echo \"Removing the placeholder main.go: go.mod is your own\"; rm -f main.go; fi; bin=\"$PWD/.aether/bin/app\"; mkdir -p .aether/bin; t=\"${buildtarget}\"; if [ \"$t\" != . ] && [ -f \"$t/go.mod\" ]; then cd \"$t\"; t=.; fi; if [ ! -f go.mod ]; then echo \"Aether Panel: there is no go.mod in the server folder. Upload your Go module, or set a git repository and reinstall.\"; exit 0; fi; if [ \"${gorun}\" = true ]; then echo \"Running ${buildtarget} with go run\"; exec go run \"$t\" ${startargs}; fi; echo \"Building ${buildtarget}\"; go build -o \"$bin\" \"$t\"; echo \"Starting ${buildtarget}\"; exec \"$bin\" ${startargs}"
